verdict.rationale: Braintrust ships an official `bt` CLI. Its docs say it lets you authenticate, trace coding-agent sessions, run evals, browse and query logs, sync data, and manage functions from the terminal, and it is positioned for setting up and running Braintrust with coding agents. Concrete subcommands (`bt view logs`, `bt sync pull`) and a probe confirming the CLI quickstart page corroborate this. Missing for 10: independent hands-on or community corroboration of the CLI in AI-native/agent workflows.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: `bt` is the command-line interface for Braintrust. It lets you authenticate, trace coding-agent sessions, run evals, browse and query logs, sync data, and manage functions without leaving your terminal.
Install the `bt` CLI to set up, instrument, and run Braintrust with your coding agent
pull them locally with `bt sync pull`
